message.content: {"decision": "answer", "answer": "The classifier was trained on scaled features but receives raw test features. A fitted Pipeline addresses this by ensuring that the same scaling transformation applied during training is applied to the test features before prediction. The Pipeline stores the transformation parameters (e.g., scaling parameters) from the training step and applies them to the test features during inference. This prevents the mismatch by standardizing the test features using the same scaling method as the training data.", "citations": ["sha256:4dd91a0b9a0a6cddba80226ff5057e0bd6f106130a98a113296b149be009afcb", "sha256:000ab67c81e879fa4c16d6060f13c7f9f28bd65ca239a017456a4ebf65085b4c"], "abstention_reason": ""}
